newsitem.title: USA: United Bankshares Q2 96 EPS includes charge.
newsitem.headline: United Bankshares Q2 96 EPS includes charge.

text.p: United Bankshares Inc said Friday its increased earnings in the second quarter from the year ago period was largely the result of its acquistion of Eagle Bancorp Inc on April 12, 1996.
A spokesman said the bank took a charge in the 1996 second quarter of 6.3 million, or $0.42 per share. Without the charge, its earnings that quarter would have been $0.52 per share.
The company reported earnings per share of $0.67 for the 1997 second quarter compared to $0.08 for the same period a year ago.
The bank also posted "strong" net interest margin of 4.77 percent and "continued excellent" asset quality enhanced its 1997 second quarter earnings.

The bank said its nonperforming assets level of 0.42 percent is at less than one-half the national average of 1.0 percent. The captial ratio remains above 11 percent and the risk-based capital ratio is double the minimum requirement of 8.0 percent.
